waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 (North Cascades Highway) to the Blue Lake Trailhead on the south side of the highway near milepost 161, just west of Washington Pass, at about 5,200 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Concord Tower summit
waypoints.directions: Hike the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 mi to a small meadow and take the climbers' path that branches left just past a small stream. Follow it up slabs, talus and meadow to the steep, loose gully between Liberty Bell and Concord Tower and climb it to the notch on Concord's north side, where the climbing starts; the route leads from there to the summit.
